text.en:
There is appropriated out of the excise tax received by the Commonwealth Government from the
United States the sum of one million pesos to be disbursed by the Director of Forestry, with the approval of
the .Secretary of Agriculture and Commerce, for the reforesta-tion and afforestation of watersheds, denuded
areas and cogon or open lands within-forest reserves, communal for-ests, national parks, and timberlands,
sand dunes, and such other areas already''certified as public forest lands, which upon investigation, are found
needing reforestation : or afforestation, or needing to be under forest cover for : the growing of economic trees
for timber, tannin, oils, gums, and other minor forest products or medicinal plants or for watershed protection,
or the prevention of erosion and floods, and the preparation of the necessary plans, estimates of costs, and

The money appropriated herein shall be available for expenditure for the purposes for which it is
appro-priated until December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and forty-one.

The Director of Forestry shall submit to the National Assembly, through the Secretary of
Agriculture and Commerce and the President of the Philippines, during the first ten days of its regular session
for the years nine teen hundred and thirty-nine, nineteen hundred and forty, nineteen hundred forty-one, and
nineteen hundred forty-two, a special report..on the result of the work of reforesta-tion and afforestation
authorized by this Act, specifying : the location and area of the sections reforested and afforested the cost of
the work accomplished, and such other data as may, in his judgment, be necessary for the information of the

The President is hereby authorized to suspend or otherwise stop the expenditure of any amount
herein ' appropriated for any purpose, or of any portion thereof, whenever in his opinion the public interest so

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 9, 1938.
